faqs.q: What should I include on a boat detailing invoice?
faqs.a: Your business details, the client's name, and enough boat identification to pick it out of a crowded marina: year, make, length overall (LOA), and slip number. Break the work into hull, deck, and interior lines priced by the foot, list specialty work (teak, canvas, isenglass) separately with units, and note the products used — compound versus polish versus ceramic — plus cure times. Marina travel and any haul-out yard fee go on their own pass-through lines.

faqs.q: How much should I charge for boat detailing?
faqs.a: A basic wash runs $2–$5 per foot of LOA ($50–$120 for a typical 24 ft boat). Full details price at $15–$30 per foot — a 20 ft bowrider lands around $300–$600 and a 30 ft cruiser $600–$1,200. Compounding and waxing adds $8–$15 per foot, teak refinishing runs $25–$50 per linear foot, and canvas or isenglass cleaning is $50–$150 per piece. Monthly hull cleaning by a diver runs $3–$5 per foot.

faqs.q: Do boat detailers charge by the foot or by the job?
faqs.a: By the foot for recurring work — washes, bottom details, seasonal packages — because LOA predicts labor almost perfectly. Flat 'by the job' pricing makes sense only after seeing the boat: a salt-caked fishing boat with three years of oxidation is a different job than a freshwater cabin cruiser of the same length. Most detailers quote per foot with a $150–$250 minimum, then upcharge for heavy oxidation or neglected interiors.

faqs.q: Should I charge extra to work at the marina or haul-out?
faqs.a: Yes — as separate lines. Travel to the marina bills as a field-service trip ($50–$100 typical), and any haul-out, lift, or blocking fee the yard charges should pass through at cost with 'pass-through' written next to it. Customers accept these charges when they see them quoted up front; they dispute them when they appear as a lump sum after the work is done.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if detailing services are not taxable in your state.
